sn48.51:1.5: The “qualities that lead to awakening” (_bodhipakkhiyā dhammā_) are none other than the five faculties themselves. This term is used repeatedly in this Saṁyutta in this sense. Outside of this context, it is used occasionally in the general sense of meditative development, without further specification ([an5.56:3.1]()). In three instances we find mention of “seven” such qualities ([dn27:30.5](), [iti82:3.1](), [iti97:4.2]()).
